text: Glurenor; Thai.: Glurenor; Turk.: Glurenorm; UK: Glurenorm†. Glisentide (rINN) Glipentide; Glisentida; Glisentidum. 1-Cyclopentyl-3-[p-(2-o-ani- samidoethyl)benzenesulphonyl]urea.
